year.purpose: Year heads of the blog index, lining figures, over a gray-7 rule.

body.purpose: Post running text; 1rem below 768px; line height is the Radix text default.

summary.purpose: A post's standfirst in muted ink; 1rem below 768px.

mark.purpose: A post's kind, all small caps; 12px on the index, 14px in a dateline.

motion.name: leader-close

components.css: .ds-index { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #f7f9f8; } .ds-entry { position: relative; padding-block: 0.3em; } .ds-line { display: flex; align-items: last baseline; column-gap: 0.5em; } .ds-title { flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; align-items: baseline; font-family: Besley, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #1a211e; text-decoration: none; } .ds-leader { position: relative; flex: 1; margin-inline-start: 0.5em; border-bottom: 2px dotted #b8bcba; } .ds-leader::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; background: #2a7e3b; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; } .ds-entry:hover .ds-leader::after, .ds-entry:focus-within .ds-leader::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-entry:hover .ds-title, .ds-entry:focus-within .ds-title { color: #2a7e3b; } .ds-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #65ba74; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-date { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #5f6563; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-summary { margin: 0; max-width: 65ch; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #5f6563; } .ds-marks { margin: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: #5f6563; } .ds-mark { font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-weight: 600; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-leader::after { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as an early-1900s trade reference: a bottle-green cloth binding at the top and bottom of every page, a cool green-gray paper between, a Clarendon for the things a reader looks up, and a plain sans for the reading itself. Posts are entries in an index, not cards in a feed; data is set as printed tables of proportions. The frame is there to be found and then forgotten.

Density is a reference book's: tight index rows, a 48em page column, a 40rem reading measure inside an 880px post column that tables, figures and code are allowed to fill. Colour is spent sparingly. One green ink marks what can be followed and where the reader stands; everything else is graphite on paper. The cloth is identical in light and dark themes, so the binding never changes while the paper does.

Motion is a single gesture: an index row's dotted leader closes into a solid rule. Nothing else on the site animates beyond the table of contents' disclosure caret.
keyCharacteristics: A fixed bottle-green cloth band for masthead and footer in both themes.
A green-tinted neutral ground (Radix sage), never cream, never pure white.
Besley, a self-hosted variable Clarendon, for wordmark, titles, section headings and index entries; system sans for everything read at length.
One accent ink (Radix grass step 11) for links, hover and the current page.
Kinds are set as small-cap marks, never as coloured badges or chips.
Tables ruled like printed proportions: heavy rule above and below, hairline under the head, no verticals, no fills, tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The accent green marks only what can be followed (links) and where the reader stands (hover, current page, focus). Inline code, kinds, dates and decoration never take it.

rules.name: The Fixed Binding Rule
rules.body: The cloth and its five companion values are literals, identical in both themes. Never re-express them as Radix steps that would flip in dark mode.

rules.name: The Look-Up Face Rule
rules.body: Besley sets only what a reader looks up: wordmark, page and post titles, section headings, years, index entries. Navigation, labels, tables and running text stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Struck Kind Rule
rules.body: A kind is told apart by its letterforms (small caps in muted ink), never by a hue or a filled chip.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or with space, never with a shadow or a card fill.

dos: **Do** take every page colour from the Radix grass and sage steps, and the binding from the six `--cloth*` literals in `identity.css`.
**Do** underline links that sit in running text or runs (0.2em offset, 1px), since the grass ink alone falls under 3:1 against dark-theme text.
**Do** set headings in Besley through `--heading-font-family` so `rt-Heading` picks it up; keep its fallback stack intact so wraps do not move on swap.
**Do** keep a post's running text in the 40rem measure and let tables, figures and code use the 880px column.
**Do** rule tables heavy-hairline-heavy with tabular figures.
donts: **Don't** colour a kind, tag or status; set it as a small-cap mark in muted ink.
**Don't** put the accent on inline code, dates, headings at rest or decoration.
**Don't** wrap posts in bordered cards or give surfaces shadows.
**Don't** set a cream or warm ground; the paper is sage.
**Don't** add vertical rules or zebra fills to tables.
**Don't** add motion beyond the leader's close and the contents caret.
